scope: Local intake, navigation and Compass presentation refactor; preview flag remains off by default.

tests.syntax: All changed browser scripts passed node --check

browser_checks: Full-page intake with six combinable choices; no setup dialog
Metres and feet, road bearing and middle-plot context reach the new workspace
New homes derive setbacks using the existing resolver
Equal-width input and preview panels; independent requirement categories
All 32 map cells fit within the available window; 16-to-32 remap preserves rooms
Browser fullscreen and explicit back-to-design/back-to-map controls
Bathroom half assignment, canonical check and accepted geometry
Advanced exact editor validates and returns to the saved Compass draft
32-cell map, split ownership and acceptance survive save/reload
limitations: No physical mobile-device or first-time-user acceptance session
This refactor does not implement the outstanding site geometry, automatic fitting or full survey-bank work
Local changes are not evidence of a new remote CI run
